in_arabic.name: حَنِفَة
in_arabic.meaning: اللاؤة و المعتدلة و الحنيفة في الدين
in_arabic.long_meaning: حَنِفَة: اللاؤة و المعتدلة و الحنيفة في الدين. من أسماء الصالحين الحنفية. نسبة إلى الحنفية، فِرَقَة مِن أهل السُنَة المالكية. و يُعتقد أنّ أصلها من الكلمة العربية الحَنِفَ، و هي: المُلتَسِم و المُوَحد. و في قَوْل النَبِي (صلى الله عليه و سلم): (حَنِفَة أُمّ حَنِفَة).

in_urdu.name: حَنِفَة
in_urdu.meaning: دین کے متعلق لاؤات و معتدلہ، دین کے حنفہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حَنِفَة: دین کے متعلق لاؤات و معتدلہ، دین کے حنفیہ۔ اس نام کا تعلق اس فرقہ سے ہے جو مالکیوں کے سنیوں کے فرقہ ہیں۔ اس نام کی ابتدا اس سے ہوئی ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ملتسم اور متحد۔ نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ و سلم نے فرما یا تھا (حَنِفَة اُم حَنِفَة)۔

in_english.name: Hanifat
in_english.meaning: Devout, faithful, righteous, upright, obedient, pious
in_english.long_meaning: Hanifat: A term referring to a devoted and righteous person, faithful to their faith and obedient to Allah's will. Derived from the Arabic root word "hanafa", meaning "to be sincere" or "to be devoted to a cause". In Islamic tradition, the term "Hanif" refers to a person who is devoted to their faith and adheres to the principles of Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used this term to describe a righteous woman, Umm Hanifah. Hanifat is a name that reflects the qualities of a devout and righteous person, and is often used to describe a woman who is strong in her faith and committed to her values.

In the Islamic tradition, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) is considered a model of Hanifat, which refers to the quality of being monotheistic and rejecting idolatry. The name Hanifat is a reminder of this fundamental tenet of Islamic faith, and it encourages moral virtues and ethical behavior.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hanifat represents the quest for inner purity and steadfastness in faith. It symbolizes the unwavering commitment to the belief in one God and the rejection of all forms of falsehood and evil. Hanifat is a reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong relationship with Allah and striving towards personal and spiritual growth. By using this name, one is constantly reminded to remain humble, kind, forgiving, and steadfast in the face of adversity, embodying the qualities of Prophet Ibrahim, and thus, living a life that honors and upholds the Islamic faith.
